fields.Name: T122 - Integrations Schedule Type Config Editor
fields.Description: Exercises the per-card schedule editor's reactive type-switching (SetScheduleType/SetInterval/SetCronExpression + GetCronDescription + HasChanges gating the Save button) — a bespoke in-card config editor unique to Schedules.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, find and open the Integrations application, and open its 'Schedules' section. On a schedule card, ensure the 'Auto-sync' toggle is on so the schedule config controls are visible, then click the 'Interval' type pill and confirm interval preset buttons (e.g. 15m/hourly) plus a custom-minutes input appear. Then click the 'Cron' type pill and confirm cron preset buttons and a cron expression input appear, with a human-readable cron description shown when an expression is set. Note that changing config surfaces a 'Save' button on the card. You do NOT need to click Save. Seeing the schedule-type pills switch the config UI reactively is success. If no schedules exist, the 'No integrations found' empty state is acceptable. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: With Auto-sync enabled, selecting the Interval pill reveals interval preset buttons and a custom-minutes input
Selecting the Cron pill reveals cron preset buttons and a cron expression input (with a description when an expression is present)
A Save button appears once the schedule configuration is changed
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
